'''Vynder''' was an individual who served in the Imperial Navy as one of the pilots of the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]]. Holding the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]], Vynder at one point took a mission on a foggy planet, where she<ref name="FFGweb">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2017/10/20/indiscriminate-devastation|text=Indiscriminate Devastation}}</ref> was pursued in a dogfight against a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing]].<ref name="Star Wing" />
